A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–E. Content can be matched reliably despite reflow and the added appendix subsection.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic convergence experiments and NoRA/NoRA+ evaluations on language, image-generation, commonsense-reasoning, and mathematical-reasoning tasks, including appendix analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and outcomes in the main text and appendices. Some attributed baseline scores do not change the presence of the work's own empirical results.

M1.justification: The Nyström initializers, ScaledGD updates, and NoRA/NoRA+ algorithms are unchanged. New Appendix A.3 explains how gradient evaluations can compute the same AΩ initialization; it does not introduce a different initializer or optimization trajectory.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same synthetic matrix-factorization scenarios, OPT few-shot tasks, dog and cat-toy image-generation tasks, LLaMA/LLaMA2 commonsense benchmarks, and MetaMathQA/GSM8K mathematical-reasoning coverage. No additional scenario is experimentally evaluated.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 2–6 and Figures 1 and 4 is unchanged. Table 1 adds comparisons of cited theoretical bounds for modified GD and ScaledGD-λ; these are not newly evaluated experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix E retain the same data splits, synthetic matrix settings, model configurations, adapter ranks, training budgets, hyperparameter searches, and evaluation procedures. Tables 7–10 contain unchanged settings.

E4.justification: The initialization-scale, perturbation, learning-rate, and damping analyses in Figures 1 and 4 are retained. The singular-value analysis in Figure 2 and the dog/cat-toy qualitative case studies also contain unchanged evidence.

E5.justification: The ± reporting in Tables 2 and 3 is unchanged. Neither version adds or revises repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, significance testing, or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: The empirical values, plotted findings, and generated examples are unchanged. For example, NoRA/NoRA+ average OPT accuracies remain 75.0/75.1, and their Gemma GSM8K accuracies remain 78.62/78.47. Table 1's additions concern previously published theoretical bounds.

T1.justification: New Appendix A.3 supplies a short mathematical argument that gradient access suffices to recover Nyström initialization, including X0 = -G0 + ΩΩᵀΩ for the symmetric problem. The existing convergence theorems, weak-optimality definitions, and proofs in Appendices B–D are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central claims: initialization determines ScaledGD's convergence behavior, Nyström initialization enables faster theoretical rates, and NoRA improves practical LoRA performance. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 4 drops the row-space containment assertion for adapter updates while retaining the column-space rationale. Section 2.2 explicitly allows other initializers satisfying the stated alignment and rank conditions, and new Appendix A.3 clarifies applicability when only gradient access is available.

D1.justification: Appendix A.3 adds operational instructions for computing initialization from a gradient at Ω in the symmetric case or at X = 0, Y = Ω in the asymmetric case. Previously, initialization was documented through direct matrix products. Experimental hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, and data-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Table 1 replaces the ScaledGD attribution to Jia et al. (2023), with small initialization, by Tong et al. (2021), with local initialization, and adds bounds from already-cited Xiong et al. (2024) and Xu et al. (2023). Section 1.1 adds concurrent-work discussion, and Appendix A.1 adds quasi-Newton positioning, but these new passages contain unresolved citations.

P1.justification: v2 adds short explanatory passages and makes limited grammatical corrections. New Appendix A.3 shifts 'More on NoRA and NoRA+' to A.4, with corresponding reference updates. The overall narrative and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains two rows and is reformatted. Existing displays reflow: Figure 3 moves from page 11 to page 12, while Tables 4 and 5 move to pages 11 and 13. Plot content, generated images, and empirical table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Appendix A.3 provides a useful implementation explanation for gradient-only access, and Table 1 presents a fuller account of prior rates and initialization requirements. These offer modest gains in clarity and context. New unresolved citations in Section 1.1 and Appendix A.1 weaken attribution, limiting the improvement; the main algorithms, existing proofs, and empirical evidence are unchanged.
